Build succeeds with zero warnings. Here's a summary of what was created:

**Project:** `RecipeCommunity` — Blazor Web App (.NET 9, Server interactivity)

**Structure:**
```
RecipeCommunity/
├── Models/Recipe.cs          — Recipe & RecipeSubmission models
├── Services/RecipeService.cs — In-memory data store with 8 seed recipes
├── Components/
│   ├── Layout/MainLayout.razor — Header nav + footer
│   ├── Shared/StarRating.razor — Interactive ★ rating widget (1–5)
│   └── Pages/
│       ├── Home.razor          — Category grid + CTA (static SSR)
│       ├── Category.razor      — Recipes filtered by category (static SSR)
│       ├── RecipeDetail.razor  — Full recipe + interactive StarRating
│       └── SubmitRecipe.razor  — Form with title/category/ingredients/steps
└── wwwroot/app.css             — Full custom styling
```

**Key design decisions:**
- **Static SSR by default** — Home, Category, and Recipe pages render server-side with no interactivity overhead
- **`@rendermode InteractiveServer`** only on `StarRating` and `SubmitRecipe` — the two components that need click/input handling
- `RecipeService` registered as singleton for shared in-memory state
- 4 categories (Italian, Indian, Mexican, Desserts) with 2 recipes each
